title_sq: Godine e pershtatshme per Hotel ne shitje!
description_sq:
Godine e pershtatshme per Hotel ne shitje, prane Rruges se Dibres!
Buze rruge, vetem pak metra nga spitali QSUT dhe Rruga e Dibres, nje zone mjafte e mire e Tiranes, fare prane unazes se vogel, me te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode.
Godina eshte 4 kateshe, me nje siperfaqe neto ndertimi prej 824.2m2, e ndertuar mbi nje truall me sip. 692m2.
- Kati perdhe ka nje sip. neto prej 175m2, i ndare ne 5 garsoniere, te gjitha me hyrje te dedikuar, tualet dhe mobilimin perkates, gjithashtu secila prej tyre me akses ne oborrin e godines.
- Kati i pare, (i dyte nga toka), ka nje siperfaqe neto prej 161.5m2 + 62.7m2 verande, i pershtatur si nje apartament 3+1, me 3 dhomat e gjumit, 2 tualete, salloni i bollshem, ambienti i gatimit dhe ngrenies i vecuar, ballkon ne secilin ambient dhe veranda.
Ashtu si kati me poshte, mund te ndahet lehtsisht ne me shume se 5 garsoniere (dhoma me tualet dhe kuzhine), dhe te shfrytezhen ne fushen e hotelerise apo qirave ditore.
- Kati i dyte, ka nje sip. neto prej 161.5m2 + 62.7m2 verande, i organizuar ne nje 2+1 te madh, me 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, salloni tejet i madh, ambienti gatimit dhe ngrenies i vecuar, ballkon ne secilin ambient dhe veranda.
Lehtesisht i adaptueshem sikatet me poshte.
- Kati i fundit, ne trajten e nje penthouse, me sip. neto 82m2 + 136.8m2 verande, i organizuar ne formen e nje apartamenti 2+1, por me mundesi ndarjen dhe pershtatjen e me shume se 2 suitave ne funksion te hotelit.
Oborri i godines ofron mundesine e parkimit per me shume se 15 makina.
Prona eshte ne gjendje shume te mire, e investuar ne cdo detaj, pjese e ne nje zone me planifikim urban mjafte ambicioz.
Aktualisht objekti eshte i dhene me qira afatgjate, me nje kthim investimi brenda 20 viteve te para.
Godina disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Building suitable for Hotel for sale!
description_en: Building suitable for a hotel for sale, near Dibra Street! On the side of the road, just a few meters from the QSUT hospital and Rruga e Dibre, a very good area of ​​Tirana, very close to the small ring road, with all the facilities for a comfortable life. The building has 4 floors, with a net construction area of ​​824.2m2, built on a plot of land. 692m2. - The ground floor has a sip. net of 175m2, divided into 5 studios, all with dedicated entrance, toilet and the corresponding furniture, also each of them with access to the courtyard of the building. - The first floor, (second from the ground), has a net area of ​​161.5m2 + 62.7m2 veranda, adapted as a 3+1 apartment, with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, spacious living room, separate cooking and dining area, balcony in each area and veranda. Just like the floor below, it can be easily divided into more than 5 studios (room with toilet and kitchen), and used in the field of hotels or daily rentals. - The second floor, there is a sip. net of 161.5m2 + 62.7m2 veranda, organized in a large 2+1, with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, very large living room, separate cooking and dining area, balcony in each area and veranda. Easily adaptable below. - The last floor, in the form of a penthouse, with a roof. net 82m2 + 136.8m2 veranda, organized in the form of a 2+1 apartment, but with the possibility of dividing and adapting more than 2 suites in the function of the hotel. The yard of the building offers the possibility of parking for more than 15 cars. The property is in very good condition, invested in every detail, part of an area with quite ambitious urban planning. Currently, the building is leased long-term, with a return on investment within the first 20 years. The building has regular mortgage documentation.
